note: 'when the Spirit of truth comes, He will guide you into all truth. For He will not speak on His own, but He will speak what He hears' (John 16:13), sent only after the Son departs (16:7).

'For just as the lightning comes from the east and flashes as far as the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.' (Matt 24:27). As ... so shall also: the comparison is stated and both terms are named. The comparison is to his COMING, not to the man.

'Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the day on which your Lord will come. But understand this: If the homeowner had known in which watch of the night the thief was coming' (Matt 24:42-43). 'So you too must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour you do not expect' (Matt 24:44): the comparison is to the hour of his coming, not to the man.
'You will grieve, but your grief will turn to joy.' (John 16:20), and the figure follows in the next verse. **The comparison is to them**, not to him.

'So when you see standing in the holy place ‘the abomination of desolation,' described by the prophet Daniel' (Matt 24:15). **He names the prophet**, which the gospels rarely do, and adds an aside to the reader in the same verse: 'let the reader understand'.

'I came from the Father and entered the world. In turn, I will leave the world and go to the Father.' (John 16:28), and 'I am not alone, because the Father is with me' (16:32).; 'I and the Father are one' (John 10:30). The verses following have his hearers take up stones.; 'Anyone who has seen Me has seen the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father'?' (John 14:9).; 'so that you may know and understand that the Father is in Me, and I am in the Father' (John 10:38).; 'the one and only Son, who is Himself God and is at the Father's side, has made Him known.' (John 1:18).
'I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech.' (John 16:25).

'As it was in the days of Noah, so will it be at the coming of the Son of Man.' (Matt 24:37). **The comparison is to the days rather than to the man** -- 24:38 spells it out as eating, drinking and marrying until the day he entered the ark -- and it is recorded on Noah because he is whom the verse names.
